name: Neobank and Fintech Account Abuse via Rapid Onboarding
description: Digital-only providers compete on fast, remote onboarding, which criminals exploit to open large numbers of accounts for fraud proceeds, pass-through and layering. Fraud rings use stolen or synthetic identities, bulk registration and automation, then operate accounts as mules or shell receptacles.

sources.text: FATF, Opportunities and Challenges of New Technologies for AML/CFT (2021)
FinCEN, Advisory to Financial Institutions on Cyber-Events and Cyber-Enabled Crime (FIN-2016-A005, 2016)

indicators.name: Burst of applications sharing devices, IPs or contact data
indicators.canon: Shared device, contact or address data across many applicants or senders
indicators.desc: The same device fingerprint, IP, phone, email or address appears across many applications, claims or apparent customers.
indicators.ctx: Many sign-ups arrive in a short period with common device fingerprints or phone/email patterns.

indicators.name: Account dormant then suddenly high-velocity inflows and outflows
indicators.canon: Dormant account suddenly reactivated or high-velocity activity
indicators.desc: A dormant or low-activity account suddenly shows high-velocity inflows and outflows.
indicators.ctx: Account opens, idles, then moves large funds quickly in a pass-through pattern.

indicators.name: Inbound payments from many unrelated sources, outbound to crypto or abroad
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Accounts act as aggregation points for third-party funds, then pay out to exchanges.

indicators.name: Identity documents or selfies reused across applicants
indicators.canon: Documents or images reused or templated across applicants
indicators.desc: Same document image, selfie, template, font or background appears across different applicants or after rejection.
indicators.ctx: Same image or template appears under multiple names or with minor edits.

indicators.name: Declared occupation or income inconsistent with account turnover
indicators.canon: Account activity inconsistent with declared occupation or income
indicators.desc: Turnover or volumes materially exceed what the customer's declared occupation, income, age or circumstances would support.
indicators.ctx: Student or unemployed applicant sees large volumes.

indicators.name: Remote access or emulator use during onboarding
indicators.canon: Remote-access, emulator or automation tools in session
indicators.desc: Remote-desktop, screen-sharing, emulator or scripted-control tools are detected during onboarding, login or payment sessions.
indicators.ctx: Sessions show remote-control tools, emulators or automation scripts.

indicators.name: Account opened for a young or elderly person but controlled by another
indicators.canon: Account opened for a young or elderly person but controlled by another
indicators.desc: Behaviour and device suggest a controller other than the account holder.
indicators.ctx: Behaviour and device suggest a controller other than the account holder.

indicators.name: Rapid sequence of new payee additions
indicators.canon: Rapid sequence of new payee additions
indicators.desc: Many new beneficiaries added in a short period, often to unrelated accounts.
indicators.ctx: Many new beneficiaries added in a short period, often to unrelated accounts.

indicators.name: Business account for newly created entity with generic purpose
indicators.canon: Newly formed entity with vague purpose and large flows
indicators.desc: Recently incorporated entity or group of entities with generic business descriptions shows significant turnover or purchases soon after formation.
indicators.ctx: Newly formed companies open accounts with vague descriptions and no web presence.

indicators.name: Referral or incentive abuse patterns
indicators.desc: Clusters of accounts claiming rewards and withdrawing promptly.
indicators.ctx: Clusters of accounts claiming rewards and withdrawing promptly.
